title: Demons and the Sledgehammer Girl
description: A woman with short black hair and pink outfit kneels on a broken stone floor, gripping a large purple sledgehammer with both hands. Two demonic figures with horns, one in a beige trench coat and the other in a purple suit, walk forward from a gothic stone archway filled with mist.
